reason: The name-and-ZIP lookup tool may only be called after an unsuccessful email lookup or when the user cannot remember their email. Neither condition is established: the user said no email is associated with the account, and no email lookup occurred. Although the policy generally permits authentication by name and ZIP, the tool's explicit prerequisite is unmet.
policy_references:
By default, find user id by email, and only call this function
if the user is not found by email or cannot remember email.
